Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the audio call recording 
of Company’s Analysts/Institutional Investors Meeting/Call held on October 28, 2026 
to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the 
Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is available on the Company’s 
website.

Investor Relations.

Investor Meet (Audio/Video Recordings) < Q2 2026 – 27.
